helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.heroDescription: Everything you need to know about hair transplant operation before and after
helpCenter.contactDescription: Our expert team is ready to help you
helpCenter.antibioticQuestion: How long should I use antibiotic cream?
helpCenter.antibioticAnswer: If your donor area has healed within 5 days after the operation, you don't need to continue using antibiotic creams.
helpCenter.hatQuestion: How long should I wear a hat after hair transplant?
helpCenter.hatAnswer: We recommend using the hat we gave you for 10 days after hair transplantation.
helpCenter.exerciseQuestion: When can I exercise after surgery?
helpCenter.exerciseAnswer: You should wait at least 1 month after the operation to start exercising.
helpCenter.washingQuestion: Should I wash my head every day after hair transplant?
helpCenter.washingAnswer: You should wash your head every day for 1 month after hair transplantation.
helpCenter.bandageQuestion: When can I remove my bandage after hair transplant?
helpCenter.bandageAnswer: You need to wash your head on the second day after the operation. The bandage is removed before washing your head and does not need to be used again.
helpCenter.specialShampooQuestion: How long should I use special shampoo?
helpCenter.specialShampooAnswer: You should use the shampoo we recommend for 1 month. After making sure your hair and scalp are healthy, you can continue using your regular shampoo.
helpCenter.panthenolDurationQuestion: How long should I use Panthenol spray?
helpCenter.panthenolDurationAnswer: You should use it for approximately 15 days, until the crusts are completely shed from the skin.
helpCenter.sexualActivityQuestion: When can I have sexual intercourse after hair transplant?
helpCenter.sexualActivityAnswer: There is no restriction on sexual intercourse after the operation, but it is recommended not to exert too much effort.
helpCenter.differentProductQuestion: Can I use a different product other than the recommended ones?
helpCenter.differentProductAnswer: You should carefully examine the content of the products you will use and prefer natural products that will not harm you and do not contain parabens.
helpCenter.panthenolDonorQuestion: Can I use Panthenol spray on the donor area?
helpCenter.panthenolDonorAnswer: You can use it, but this will cause the spray to run out very quickly.

about.title: About
about.description: Smile Hair Clinic is one of the leading clinics in the field of hair transplantation in Istanbul, Turkey's crown jewel.
about.leadershipDesc: Led by internationally renowned Dr. Gökay Bilgin and Dr. Mehmet Erdoğan, Smile Hair Clinic always prioritizes patient satisfaction.
about.processDesc: All operation processes are personally supervised by doctors, and successful hair transplant procedures are performed on numerous patients from Turkey and abroad every year.
about.consultationDesc: Together with our expert team, we address each patient's hair loss problems and offer personalized solutions with detailed planning. We plan every detail together, from hairline design to your expectations.
about.operationDesc: Operation day is the most important day for a successful result throughout the transformation process. Therefore, we don't let anything go wrong. We mobilize all our efforts and resources to achieve successful operations and results.
about.innovationDesc: We see development as the foundation of medicine. We always use the most effective hair transplantation techniques and continuously improve ourselves.
